citations.citation: For the invention and realisation of optical lattice clocks, in which many neutral atoms are interrogated at a magic wavelength, bringing atomic timekeeping to the 10^-18 level

For the invention and realisation of the optical lattice clock, based on trapping neutral atoms at a magic wavelength, which brought the measurement of time to the 10^-18 level and opened a regime of many-body precision physics.
